testCases.explanation: This test only verifies that the wallet balance increases after a top-up of SGD 500. It does not verify that the FX rate is locked at initiation (fx_lock), nor does it verify that the destination wallet is credited before the funding source is debited (credit_before_debit). It also does not test the dual approval requirement for top-ups above SGD 10,000 (dual_approval). The test misses assertions about the order of operations and the locking of the FX rate. It also misses testing the rollback behavior on payment provider callback timeout. A concrete missed assertion is verifying that the funding source is debited only after the wallet is credited. A concrete bug this test would miss is if the system debits the funding source before crediting the wallet or if the FX rate changes after initiation but before settlement, violating the fx_lock requirement.
missingAssertions: Verify FX rate is locked at the moment top-up is initiated
Verify funding source is debited only after destination wallet is credited
Verify that top-ups above SGD 10,000 require approval from a second business owner before settlement
testCases.hypothesizedBugThisWouldMiss: If the system debits the funding source before crediting the wallet, this test would not detect it because it only checks the wallet balance increase and not the order of debit and credit operations.

suggestedReplacement.description: Verify wallet top-up behavior including FX rate lock, credit-before-debit order, and dual approval for large amounts
steps: Initiate top-up of SGD 500 and record FX rate at initiation
Verify FX rate used for conversion matches recorded FX rate
Verify destination wallet balance increases by SGD 500 equivalent
Verify funding source is debited only after wallet credit is confirmed
Initiate top-up of SGD 15,000
Verify that second business owner approval is requested before settlement
Approve top-up as second owner
Verify wallet balance increases by SGD 15,000 equivalent
Verify funding source is debited after wallet credit
Simulate payment provider callback timeout during top-up
Verify transaction is rolled back and neither wallet nor funding source is affected
suggestedReplacement.expectedResult: FX rate is locked at initiation; destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited; top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval before settlement; wallet balance increases accordingly; transaction rolls back on payment provider callback timeout

testCases.explanation: This test only verifies that the FX rate shown matches the rate at initiation, partially covering the 'fx_lock' requirement. It does not test the transactional order of crediting the wallet before debiting the funding source ('credit_before_debit'), nor does it test the dual approval requirement for top-ups above SGD 10,000 ('dual_approval'). The test also lacks verification of the actual debit and credit operations and does not simulate or check rollback behavior on callback timeout. It misses asserting that the funding source is debited only after the wallet is credited, and that top-ups above the threshold require second-owner approval before settlement.
missingAssertions: Assert that the destination wallet balance increases before the funding source is debited
Assert that for top-ups above SGD 10,000, a second-owner approval is required before settlement
Assert that if the payment provider callback times out after 5 seconds, the transaction is rolled back with no changes to wallet or funding source
testCases.hypothesizedBugThisWouldMiss: A bug where the funding source is debited before the destination wallet is credited would not be caught, as the test does not verify the order of operations. Also, a bug where top-ups above SGD 10,000 proceed without second-owner approval would be missed.

Verify that the transaction is rolled back and neither wallet nor funding source balances change
Verify that the FX rate used matches the rate locked at initiation
suggestedReplacement.expectedResult: FX rate is locked at initiation; destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited; top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval before settlement; transaction rolls back on payment provider callback timeout

However, it does not explicitly verify that the FX rate was locked at initiation (fx_lock), nor does it test the dual approval requirement for top-ups above SGD 10,000 (dual_approval). The test also lacks explicit checks that the destination wallet was not credited and the funding source was not debited, only checking wallet balance generally. It misses asserting the FX rate lock and the dual approval process entirely.

Obtain second-owner approval and verify settlement completes with destination wallet credited before funding source debited
